summary: Double catalyst Friday: Core PCE 8:30 AM + Russell Reconstitution after close. Nikkei crashes -4.72% overnight (full reversal of Thursday +4.61%). BTC breaks below $60K to $59,780. AAPL -6.1% on chip shortage price hikes. MU rebounds +16.2% on earnings. Dow hit intraday ATH 52,655 then reversed. Regime: ERO 46.5%, crisis fading to 21.5%. Commodities resume selloff: silver -3.2%, WTI -2.0%.

risks.label: Nikkei -4.72% crash — largest single-day reversal in months
risks.detail: Nikkei 225 plunged from 72,366 to 68,949, erasing Thursday's entire +4.61% recovery. Carry-trade unwind risk if USD/JPY breaks below 160. End-of-quarter liquidation by Japanese institutions. Contagion risk to US session via global risk sentiment.

risks.label: BTC breaks below $60K — 52W low in sight at $58,397
risks.detail: Bitcoin at $59,780, just $1,383 above 52W low. ETH at $1,546 (-5.88%), $40 from 52W low. Capitulation volume $44.8B/24h. Crypto bear market structure confirmed — all majors below 50D and 200D MAs.

risks.label: Core PCE Friday — binary catalyst for regime direction
risks.detail: Fed's preferred inflation gauge at 8:30 AM ET. Hot (>0.3% MoM) = crisis re-acceleration, VIX past 20, bond selloff. Cool (<=0.2%) = relief rally, potential regime upgrade. Coincides with Russell Reconstitution = extreme gamma.

risks.label: AAPL -6.1% crash — memory chip shortage supply chain shock
risks.detail: Apple plunged on MacBook/iPad price hikes driven by memory chip shortage. RSI 33.5 oversold. Structural headwind: AI boom diverting HBM/DRAM capacity from consumer electronics. Nasdaq -0.46%.

risks.label: Commodity selloff resumes — silver -3.2%, oil -2.0%
risks.detail: After a brief stabilization, commodities resume their decline. Gold $4,025 (-0.56% RSI 32.2), Silver $56.49 (-3.21%), WTI $70.48 (-2.0%), Copper -1.65%. Broad commodity weakness signals potential global demand slowdown.

risks.label: Hang Seng hits 52-week low — China pessimism deepens
risks.detail: HSI at 22,644.49 (-1.87%), intraday low 22,518 = fresh 52W low. Property sector and deflationary pressures weigh. China recovery narrative fading rapidly.

risks.label: VIX 18.89 drifting higher — 20 threshold critical
risks.detail: VIX settled at 18.89, up from 18.63. Still sub-20 but trending higher. Sustained close above 20 = volatility regime change. Core PCE + Reconstitution could trigger spike.

risks.label: Iran-Hormuz standoff — oil below $75 but tail risk persists
risks.detail: WTI $70.48, Brent $74.10. Market calling bluff on Hormuz blockade. But any sudden escalation = Brent $95-100+ immediately. Complacency risk while geopolitical tension is unresolved.

events.label: Core PCE Price Index — TODAY 8:30 AM ET
events.detail: Fed's preferred inflation gauge. Hot (>0.3%) = risk-off acceleration. Cool (<=0.2%) = regime upgrade potential. THE most important data point this week.

events.label: Russell Reconstitution — TODAY After Close
events.detail: $12 trillion in benchmarked assets rebalance. Extreme volume in final hour. IWM at $298.91, near 52W high. Additions get tailwind; deletions face pressure.

events.label: Consumer Sentiment + Personal Income — TODAY
events.detail: Michigan final consumer sentiment + personal income/spending data. Consumption health assessment for Q3 outlook.

events.label: NKE (Nike) Earnings — Monday Jun 30 AMC
events.detail: Consumer discretionary bellwether. Weak = discretionary spending slowdown confirmed. China recovery thesis test.

events.label: ISM Manufacturing PMI — Tuesday Jul 1
events.detail: National factory health. Sub-50 = contraction risk. Key for industrial sector direction and recession narrative.

events.label: FOMC Minutes — Wednesday Jul 2
events.detail: June meeting minutes. Rate path clarity. Hawkish surprise = risk-off acceleration. Dovish = relief rally potential.

opportunities.label: IWM — Russell Reconstitution catalyst, near 52W high
opportunities.detail: Russell 2000 ETF at $298.91, 0.9% from 52W high. Reconstitution today provides mechanical tailwind. Above both EMAs, RSI 61.6. Rotation from mega-cap tech to small-cap value accelerating.

opportunities.label: TLT — Flight to quality, above EMAs, 10Y falling
opportunities.detail: TLT at $87.35, above both EMAs, RSI 65.0. 10Y yield at 4.39% and falling. Cool Core PCE = bond rally toward $89.50+. Highest-conviction defensive play.

opportunities.label: MU post-earnings momentum — AI memory thesis validated
opportunities.detail: MU +16.2% after blowout Q3 earnings. Revenue guidance $10.5B+ for Q4. HBM3E demand insatiable. Memory chip shortage bullish for fabs and equipment makers (ASML, AMAT).

opportunities.label: ASML — Existing position, monopoly EUV provider
opportunities.detail: 5 shares @ $1,841.18, unrealized +$539. Memory chip shortage = more fab orders. Trail stop $1,700. Add on dip below $1,800 if PCE cool.

opportunities.label: NVS — EU healthcare leader, PE 15.6x, Score 86
opportunities.detail: Top defensive pick. Above all EMAs, RSI 60.5. Div 3.1%, beta ~0.5. Kisqali/Entresto franchise. Entry $154-156, stop $150.50, TP1 $164.

regime_blips.label: Crisis probability fades to 21.5% from 35.9% — ERO dominant
regime_blips.detail: Ensemble: ERO 46.5% (dominant), crisis 21.5% (below 30% threshold), neutral 24.8%, risk-on 7.3%. Score 28.8/100. Second consecutive de-escalation. Core PCE is the binary catalyst for next regime shift.

regime_blips.label: Dow hit ATH intraday 52,655 then reversed 735 points
regime_blips.detail: Shooting star candle on the Dow. Distribution signal: institutions selling into the breakout. US value (DIA, IWM) technically strongest indices — both above 20 and 50-day EMAs.

regime_blips.label: Global decoupling extreme — US vs Rest of World divergence
regime_blips.detail: US equities near highs while Nikkei -4.72%, Hang Seng 52W low, BTC <$60K, commodities crashing. DXY at 101.41. This divergence historically resolves with convergence — either US drops or RoW recovers.

regime_blips.label: Semi recovery: MU +16.2%, AMAT +10.5%, tech sector +6%
regime_blips.detail: Semiconductor theme staged massive recovery led by MU earnings. AAPL -6.1% is the mirror image — memory shortage bullish for fabs, bearish for consumers. Bifurcated tech thesis.

regime_blips.label: Small-cap rotation accelerating — IWM RSI 61.6, near 52W high
regime_blips.detail: Russell 2000 +0.71% to 3,007.86. Above both EMAs. Reconstitution today. Value over growth, domestic over mega-cap. This is a structural rotation, not a one-day event.

regime_blips.label: DXY softening at 101.41 — dollar weakness favors internationals
regime_blips.detail: Dollar index -0.02%. Weak dollar benefits EU/APAC stocks. If Core PCE cools, dollar weakens further = tailwind for international positions.
